_readme: SIMULATED AUTHORISED-DEALER REGISTRY. Every record is invented.
This stands in for the Form 29B authorisation state that Rule 55A makes a
precondition for acting as a dealer of registered vehicles. It is NOT a copy of,
feed from, or lookup against any government register.
simulated_revalidation_status exists to make test T13 (dealer expires between
verification and submission) demonstrable without waiting on a clock. When present,
the registry reports `status` on the first check and `simulated_revalidation_status`
when SubmissionService revalidates at submit time. This is a declared property of a
declared simulation, not a hidden bypass -- the demo scenario card names it.
